successMetrics: 25 thesis-aligned investor targets scored and segmented.
10 warm-intro paths or high-context direct outreach paths identified.
5 investor conversations booked or clear, categorized objections captured.
Investor objections translated into validated product/demo/proof improvements.
standardDiscoveryWorkflow: Start with LinkedIn keyword searches for AI infrastructure, developer tools, agentic workflows, autonomous software engineering, devops automation, low-code, enterprise automation and AI coding investors.
Filter by stage fit, geography flexibility, portfolio relevance, recent AI/devtools activity and partner/operator background.
Cross-check each candidate against public firm portfolio pages, Crunchbase-style funding records, AngelList/Wellfound-style profiles, newsletters, podcasts and conference appearances.
Use Apollo API enrichment only after a candidate is already scored as relevant and only if APOLLO_API_KEY is configured, rate limits are respected and spend is approved when required.
Score each investor on thesis fit, portfolio adjacency, ability to help, intro path quality, recent activity, check size/stage fit and evidence-first narrative fit.
Map warm-intro paths through existing customers, founders, agencies, cloud/startup programs, LinkedIn mutual connections and AI builder communities before sending direct outreach.
Log every target, source URL, reason for fit, outreach status, response, objection, next step and resulting product/self-improvement action.
linkedinOperatingRules: Use LinkedIn for manual research, relationship mapping and high-context outreach; do not scrape, spam, automate connection requests or violate platform rules.
Prefer warm introductions and thoughtful direct messages tied to the investor's public thesis or portfolio evidence.
Keep outreach volume controlled and track quality signals instead of optimizing for bulk sends.
Do not use paid databases, Sales Navigator, Apollo enrichment, enrichment tools or external APIs unless the monetary approval gate approves any incremental spend.

Prioritize investors who mention AI infrastructure, developer tools, autonomous agents, devops, enterprise productivity or SaaS automation.
Save only qualified candidates with source URL, thesis evidence, portfolio evidence, warm-intro path and next action.
Use Apollo enrichment only after a candidate passes manual fit scoring and only when API usage is approved/configured.
